meta.title: MINDBLOWING HAI VAN PASS 🇻🇳 | Motorbike Journey from Hoi An to Hue
meta.description:
Today I left Hoi An  on an easy rider heading to Hue, Via the Hai Van Pass, which is said to be one of the most scenic drives in the world. It not only has history, but the mind blowing scenery continues to change along the way. From mountains, coastlines, to farms and rice fields. There is so much to see on the unforgettable highway. This was one of my favorite adventures yet! I feel like if you are going to do your first motorbike trip it really should be on one of the most scenic drives in the world. 

If you are visiting the area and want to do the trip I highly recommend you book with my driver Ky! He is the best!
